Mechanism narration is imprecise (not verdict-breaking): the prompt's 'Claimed mechanism' asserts that after Escape 'activeElement is #q with a 0x0 box inside a display:none container.' My Puppeteer probe contradicts this — applying display:none (closeSearch removes the .open class) causes Chromium to auto-blur the hidden #q input and revert activeElement to document.body (afterEsc.activeId = 'BODY', activeIsBody = true, activeInsideHiddenOverlay = false). Focus is NOT stranded on #q; it falls back to the document. The .md doc itself is more accurate on this point (line 36: 'falls back toward the document/body') though it also carries a loose clause ('focus is left on a hidden node'). Recommend tightening the wording so it does not claim focus remains on #q.
